_meta.description: Baseline metadata for Lahore's 5 official administrative tehsils (2023 census), used by HoshiyarLahore.
_meta.spatial_unit: Lahore administrative tehsils (2023 Census of Pakistan, pre-2024 five-tehsil structure)

data_provenance.population: 2023 Census of Pakistan, PBS Table 1 (Punjab), Lahore District. Official figures. Source: https://www.pbs.gov.pk/wp-content/uploads/census_tables/tables/table_1_punjab_districts.pdf . The five tehsils sum to 13,004,135 (district total in the same table is 13,004,135; the ~1.99M difference is the 'restricted/uncounted' district-level residual PBS lists separately).
data_provenance.area_km2: 2023 Census / PBS Table 1, column 'AREA SQ.K.M'. Official tehsil areas.
data_provenance.population_density: 2023 Census / PBS Table 1, 'POPULATION DENSITY PER SQ.K.M'. Matches population/area.
data_provenance.centroid: Approximate tehsil centroid (WGS84), used to query weather. Refine from OSM boundaries when available.
data_provenance.vegetation_deficit: Proxy 0.0-1.0 estimating built-up / vegetation-poor character (1.0 = fully built-up). ESTIMATE, not a census figure - see docs/DATA_SOURCES.md.
data_provenance.elevation_band: Rough elevation category. Lahore is generally flat (~210-220m).

_meta.verification_status: Population, area, and density for all 5 tehsils are OFFICIAL 2023 census figures from PBS Table 1 (verified=true). Only vegetation_deficit and centroid are estimates. Sum of 5 tehsils = 13,004,135.
_meta.IMPORTANT: vegetation_deficit is a land-cover proxy, not a census statistic. In 2024 Punjab split Lahore into 10 tehsils; this build intentionally uses the original 5-tehsil structure that matches the 2023 census cleanly.

towns.name: Lahore City Tehsil
towns.notes: Central urban core including the historic Walled City. Extremely dense, low vegetation, strongest urban heat-island effect. 2023 census.

towns.name: Shalimar Tehsil
towns.notes: Dense neighbourhoods along the Grand Trunk Road (Harbanspura, Mughalpura). 2023 census.

towns.name: Model Town Tehsil
towns.notes: Large planned southern tehsil (Model Town, Johar Town, Garden Town); more tree cover than the old city. 2023 census.

towns.name: Lahore Cantonment Tehsil
towns.notes: Includes DHA, Cantt, Walton, Bedian, Burki; greener and lower density. 2023 census.

towns.name: Raiwind Tehsil
towns.notes: Large peri-urban / agricultural tehsil on the southern edge; lowest density, most vegetation. 2023 census.
